title: Harden the ValidationResult public contract (read-only issues, deterministic ordering, typed location, cached validity)
description:
## Summary
The 2026-09-06 second-order audit (creaturecreator-second-order-codebase-audit-26-09-06-17-18-00.md) found ValidationResult exposes an immutable-looking facade over a mutable list and over-claims ordering independence.

## Scope
Runtime/Definition/ValidationResult.cs and ValidationIssue.cs:
- F-201 (P1): `Issues => _issues` returns the mutable `List` behind `IReadOnlyList` (`ValidationResult.cs:18,22`). Make the issue collection genuinely read-only after construction.
- F-202 (P1/P2): Sorting is only by PartId->Code->Severity (`ValidationResult.cs:26-35`), but the header doc claims full order-independence (`ValidationResult.cs:8-15`). Make ordering deterministic (document tie-break or total order) and align the doc.
- F-203 (P2): Semantic locations are embedded in free-text `Message` (`ValidationIssue.cs:31-37`). Introduce typed location data (body-sample index / limb-joint index / field name) where the validator has it.
- F-204 (P3): `IsValid => !_issues.Any(...)` recomputes on every access (`ValidationResult.cs:20`); compute once at construction.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Issues cannot be mutated through the returned view; a focused test asserts immutability.
- Issue ordering is deterministic and matches a documented total order.
- A typed location field exists for at least one issue kind that currently embeds location in Message.
- IsValid is a stable cached value.

## Validation
Focused DefinitionValidator/Runtime tests; dotnet Tests build clean.

## Findings
Confirmed at HEAD d3c7f12e. No existing task owns the ValidationResult contract (TSK-0082 is Done and unrelated). Note: F-201 also sits under the TSK-0095 immutable-artifact umbrella; this task is the narrowest owner. See docs/audits/creaturecreator-audit-synthesis-2026-09-06-batch.md.

## Blockers
None.

## Next Step
Implement the ValidationResult contract hardening; add focused tests.

comments.body:
Implemented contract hardening (working tree only; NOT committed). Owning task TSK-0138.

Changed files:
- Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Definition/ValidationResult.cs (F-201/F-202/F-204)
- Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Definition/ValidationIssue.cs (F-203 property + non-breaking ctor param)
- Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Definition/ValidationIssueLocation.cs (NEW)
- Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Definition/DefinitionValidator.cs (2 issue sites now emit typed location; messages unchanged)
- Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/ValidationResultContractTests.cs (NEW focused tests)

Design decisions (flagging for orchestrator):
- F-201 read-only: backing field retyped `List<>` -> `IReadOnlyList<>`, assigned via `sorted.AsReadOnly()` (ReadOnlyCollection). No element copy cost (sort ToList was already done; AsReadOnly is a zero-copy wrapper). Callers mutating through the IList<T> facet get NotSupportedException.
- F-202 total order: PartId(ordinal, null-first) -> Code -> Severity -> Message(ordinal) final tie-break; XML doc rewritten to state the total order and that only fully-identical issues are unordered (immaterial). Adding Message tie-break only reorders prior exact ties, so existing elementwise A-vs-B determinism tests still pass.
- F-203 typed location: new nullable ValidationIssueLocation? on ValidationIssue carrying Kind (BodySample | LimbJoint) + Index; enum has ONLY the two kinds actually emitted (no dead/speculative members). Populated at two real validator sites that embed the index in Message: null body sample (InvalidBodySample, index i) and null limb joint (InvalidLimbChain, index i). Messages unchanged (location supplements, never replaces text). Optional ctor param keeps all existing call sites compiling.
- F-204 IsValid cached: private readonly bool computed once in ctor from the sorted list.

Validation gate:
- dotnet build --no-restore: ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj 0 err/0 warn; ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj 0 err/0 warn; ProceduralCreature.Editor.csproj 0 err/0 warn. EXIT 0 each.
- get_errors: no diagnostics in the 5 touched files.
- Unity refresh (force, scope all, compile requested): bridge idle, Unity console 0 errors/0 warnings; Unity generated .meta for both new files (ValidationIssueLocation.cs.meta, ValidationResultContractTests.cs.meta).
- git diff --check: EXIT 0 (only benign LF->CRLF warnings on pre-existing line endings).

Not executed (blocker): Unity Test Runner run of the focused tests and existing DefinitionValidator tests could not be performed — no test-run tool is exposed in this session. Tests compile clean via Tests.Runtime csproj. Next step: run ValidationResultContractTests + DefinitionValidator* tests in Unity EditMode/PlayMode once a test-runner is available.

comments.body: Sprint R5 orchestrator review: independently ran focused PlayMode ValidationResultContractTests -> 7/7 passed (Issues read-only view immutability; total-order deterministic across construction with Message final tie-break; IsValid cached; typed BodySample + LimbJoint location; null-when-not-provided). Then ran FULL Runtime PlayMode suite (ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime) -> 617/617 passed, 0 failed (~6.0s) — confirms the ValidationResult ordering/immutability change causes no regression in existing DefinitionValidator/validation tests. Implementation: ValidationResult backing List->IReadOnlyList via AsReadOnly (zero-copy), documented total order (PartId ordinal->Code->Severity->Message), readonly cached _isValid; new immutable ValidationIssueLocation(Kind BodySample|LimbJoint, Index) populated at two real validator sites (messages untouched); optional trailing ctor param preserves all existing call sites. dotnet Runtime/Tests/Editor builds clean; Unity compiles 0 errors; git diff --check clean.
